title: astragalus sempervirens var. gussonei
intro: Astragalus sempervirens var. gussonei, commonly known as the Italian milk-vetch or Astragalus gussonei, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This perennial herb is known for its traditional uses in medicine and health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which are associated with the presence of various bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents in Astragalus sempervirens var. gussonei have been reported to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities, contributing to its potential health benefits.
